After the active validation freeze ends and is reconciled, repair the remaining first-send recovery ownership below and obtain current compiler/unit, native browser, full ALL and fresh affected review evidence. findings.title: First-send recovery state can outlive its authoritative attempt
findings.rationale: PrimeiraMensagem retains consulted, recoveredAttempt and confirmRisk across attempt changes, while its component key identifies navigation rather than the attempt. After consulting A, releasing A and creating B in the same conversation, recovery presentation still uses consulted ?? attempt, so A's cached facts and eligibility timestamp can describe B. If A was released elsewhere and discovered through consultation, confirmRisk is not reset either. Also, only the child's reloadOptions clears recoveredAttempt on activeAttempt:null; a newer accepted parent observation does not independently retire that fallback, which still participates in locked. The shared-ticket checks repair the reviewed late-GET path, but these remaining local authorities conflict with DOD-06 and the unresolved D04 requirement. This is a static finding, not a claimed runtime reproduction.
findings.suggested_action: Scope cached recovery facts and risk confirmation to the current attempt ID. Ensure accepted authoritative observations, including activeAttempt:null, retire obsolete local fallback state. Extend native coverage to consecutive first-send attempts within one mounted conversation, verifying B's facts, fresh consent and retirement of A without repeated provider dispatch.
